source: Public didactic data; spec/tasks.json and user request
grammar: trimmed sign? digits (comma-or-dot digits)? optional known unit; U+2212 minus; no grouping, exponents, fractions, multiple values or prose. Leading-zero integers with >1 digit and separator followed by exactly three digits with nonzero fractional tail are ambiguous grouping: clarify. Max 128 characters, 40 digits.
unitPolicy: Missing unit uses visible field unit. Known mismatching unit is incorrect; unknown additions clarify. Never rescale fractions to percent.
wrong: incorrect, concrete comparison without guessing the reasoning
context: exact versioned material; edit/help/reset invalidates receipt; help monotonic within session; no raw text persistence; writing unassessed
